description: An atmosphere only experiment following piClim-control, but with the sea surface temperatures that are uniformly 4K warmer and with present-day (2021) anthropogenic aerosol emissions. Sea surface temperatures should be prescribed with a climatology that is 4K warmer, but otherwise identical, to the climatology used in piClim-control. Sea ice concentrations should be prescribed with the same pre-industrial climatology used in piClim-control and all other forcings should be set to pre-industrial (1850) conditions as in piClim-control. In combination with piClim-p4K, piClim-control and piClim-aer, this experiment can be used to evaluate the sensitivity of anthropogenic aerosol radiative forcing to a warmer background state.
